steps.note: R49: Victoria's route. With Victoria recruited, entering the restricted stacks makes HaX text that her people read the building's mail (a mapping text), and the hub grows a Can Victoria's people row. Asking sets maintenance_code_used and HaX gives the code and the print cabinet clue. The row stays until the cage opens (no given flag, by design); the mapping text does not repeat once the code is used.

said: First time we've used Victoria. Her people read this building's mail. Ask me about that gate
[choice] Can Victoria's people get me through that gate
There's a maintenance code for that gate. Sorensen never changed it
The cabinet in there takes her print. It's on the stamp on her shelf
